title: %get — read a property with an optional default
purpose: Read a value at a key path from an object, falling back to a default when absent.
notes: The second argument is a quoted key or dot path ("a.b.c"); the resolved value keeps its type.
An optional third argument is returned when the path is missing or references an unsafe property; with no default a miss yields ~.
A non-object first argument returns the default (or ~).
